description: Inset a 3D Mass — shrink (Inside) or grow (Outside) its footprint by Offset → a new Mass. Feed a Mass from Space to 3D.
instructions:
A Mass op — insets (or outsets) each incoming Mass's footprint by Offset (Inside shrinks, Outside grows), producing a new Mass. Feed a Mass (from a Mass node, or Space → 3D); the host extrudes the inset footprint.

TIP: chain Inset 3D → Smoothing 3D to taper and round a massing block; stack several Inset 3D for a stepped tower.
